input_scope: 35 existing train-only issued forecast events; current outcomes held by coordinator

calibration.model: two-dimensional local level, independent state innovations and temporally white observation noise
calibration.clock: activity ordinal; missing pair gap multiplies Q
calibration.raw_negative_eigenvalues: retain and report; PSD projection separate sensitivity
calibration.initial_likelihood: conditional on first complete observation; mean=y0,P=R
calibration.anchor_selection: actual support-grid entries at 0/50/100 percentiles of trace(Q)/trace(R), tie NLL then grid index
uncertainty: all profile points and support band
raw moment moving-block bootstrap 500 draws lengths 1/3/5

real_diagnostics.BH_family: each calibration/diagnostic segment across available rank/phase/raw-or-difference p values

bootstrap.contributions: Original ending activity attaches level, actual adjacent level pair, delta and actual adjacent delta pair; sample blocks of these attached contributions, never re-difference stitched levels
bootstrap.covariance_convention: Gamma0 sample denominator n-1; Gamma1 average across real lag-pairs centered by delta mean

real_diagnostics.next_period_target: issued S minus issued I event loss; ten diagnostic activities, all phases; descriptive rank correlation and delete-one range

B_interface.name: risk_recent_k8
B_interface.issued_experts: original I/S saved before release, never re-fitted after label

simulation.contamination: 95% N(0,1)+5% N(0,25), divide sqrt(2.2); same covariance after R square root
simulation.shift_persistence: permanent after state innovation at event26
simulation.release: latest available label before event e is e-1-delay; issue first, then ordered release
simulation.oracle: diagnostic only; true generation Q/R and initial mean; no future shocks
simulation.DLM_fit: Gaussian likelihood minimizer from calibration segment; fixed across regimes
simulation.MC_unit: independent path; 300 across seeds; report per seed too

limitations: retrospective explored training cohort; last10 is not prospective evidence
old test explored and validation reused, neither read here
Q/R mechanism conditional on local-level and white-noise assumptions
base V3 tree changes with historical training size
profile support band has no nominal coverage
simulation benefits conditional on generated regimes, no universal real advantage

supersedes.reason: PI pre-execution review: resample original attached lag/difference contributions; no reconstructed adjacency at block seams
